newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NZ SPORT-Fitzpatrick in doubt for test vs Aussies.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT-Fitzpatrick in doubt for test vs Aussies.

text.p: MELBOURNE, July 23 - Sean Fitzpatrick has only a 40 percent chance of playing in Saturday's Bledisloe Cup tri-series rugby test in Melbourne, All Black coach John Hart said on Wednesday.
NZPA reports the All Black captain consulted a specialist in Melbourne yesterday regarding his injured knee.
The specialist was not optimistic he would play.
"The specialist said there are a few bodies floating in there," the All Black hooker said.
Hart said Fitzpatrick's playing prospects had diminished to about 40 percent, opening the way for hooker Norm Hewitt to play his sixth test.
Fitzpatrick said he would like to play but had to wait until Friday or even until Saturday for the final decision.
Fitzpatrick was injured in last Sunday morning's (NZT) 35-32 test win over South Africa in Johannesburg which gave the All Blacks a solid start to the tri-series competition.
The other injured player, winger Tana Umaga, took a restricted part in yesterday's training at the Powerhouse Rugby Club. Umaga is also in doubt, with an arm-shoulder problem picked up last Sunday.
However, fullback Christan Cullen took full part in training and it appears he will play. Cullen strained an arm muscle.
